date_scope_check.qualification: C7-SC-003-P1: The KGB-announced window is 34 hours, from 20:00 on 24 May to 06:00 on 26 May 2019. Actual implementation at individual posts and completed reopening were not established. The duration describes the order, not verified elapsed closure.
